articles.title: VRS payout tax: Is severance pay taxable? Pune ITAT rules ₹65.21 lakh Pfizer retirement payout was not taxable
articles.summary: Pune ITAT has ruled that a ₹65.21 lakh payout received by a Pfizer employee under a voluntary retirement scheme was a capital receipt and not taxable. The tribunal said Section 56(2)(xi) did not apply because the employee had voluntarily resigned under the scheme, rather than being terminated.

articles.title: EPF Coverage Missed For Eligible Workers? EPFO Opens Special Enrolment Window Till October 31, 2026
articles.summary: EPFO’s Employees’ Enrolment Campaign (EEC) 2026 gives employers a one-time opportunity to enrol eligible workers who were missed from EPF coverage between April 1, 2009 and March 31, 2026. articles.title: 8th Pay Commission pension rules: Why employee and pensioner bodies want faster restoration of commuted pension
articles.summary: Central government pensioners and employee associations want the 8th Pay Commission to reduce the 15-year commuted pension restoration period to 10–12 years.
